scope: Conditional research paths, not verified causal effects or return predictions

drafts.title: CoreWeave capital spending and financing channel
drafts.conditional_path: CoreWeave's FY2026 capital-expenditure guidance and Q4 interest-expense guidance create a testable two-sided path. If infrastructure is delivered on the stated schedule, equipment and capacity suppliers with separately verified contracts could see orders; if funding costs or deployment timing worsen, CoreWeave's cash needs and margins could face pressure. The supplier links and technology-sector market effect have not been established in this intake.

drafts.title: CPI, policy expectations and financing channel
drafts.conditional_path: A future CPI release can be compared with a documented, timestamped pre-release consensus. If the result changes expected policy rates, financing costs and valuation assumptions could shift for capital-intensive technology firms. The October 2026 CPI card has an official actual and prior value but no qualified consensus, so no surprise, rate-expectation change, company effect or market reaction is asserted here.
